name: tribetails
description: Monorepo entry point. mytribe/web, auntieos-admin, and packages/* are real npm workspaces, sharing one install and one root package-lock.json — that's how packages/geo's route geometry reaches both web apps. mytribe/functions and auntieos-admin/web/functions are deliberately NOT workspace members: Cloud Functions deploy as self-contained artifacts with their own package.json and lockfile, and hoisting their deps into the root tree would ship a broken deploy. These scripts exist so a task has ONE name from the repo root instead of a path to memorise.

scripts.test: npm run test:functions && npm run test:geo && npm run test:admin && npm run test:portal
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:functions && npm run typecheck:geo && npm run typecheck:admin && npm run typecheck:portal
scripts.build: npm run build:functions && npm run build:admin && npm run build:portal
scripts.e2e:cy: npm run e2e:cy:admin && npm run e2e:cy:portal
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run contracts:check && npm run seeds:check && npm test && npm run build
